sections.title: Items
sections.note: Upgrades of one item are its tiers. Item Upgrades shares this progress and totals the materials.

items.name: Sailcloth
items.howTo: Zelda gives it to you on the Statue of the Goddess for winning the Wing Ceremony.
items.notes: Open it while falling to land safely, as when you jump off your Loftwing. HD: the Zelda & Loftwing amiibo takes you up to the Sky from anywhere on the Surface, even in a dungeon, and back to the same spot.

items.name: Slingshot
items.notes: Zelda Wiki prices the Scattershot at 20 Rupees; Zelda Dungeon and Samurai Gamers say 50. HD: with button controls you aim it with the right stick instead of pointing the Wii Remote.

tiers.name: Slingshot
tiers.howTo: Bucha, the Kikwi elder in Faron Woods, gives it to you once you've found the three hiding Kikwis.

tiers.name: Scattershot
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Slingshot at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 2 Dusk Relics, 2 Amber Relics, 3 Jelly Blobs and 50 Rupees.
tiers.reward: Charge a shot to scatter one Deku Seed over a wide area

items.name: Bug Net
items.notes: Catches bugs, Fairies, Tumbleweeds and Chirris (whose feathers are treasures). Beedle's shop flies over Skyloft by day: hit the bell underneath with the Slingshot or Beetle to be pulled up.

tiers.name: Bug Net
tiers.howTo: Buy it at Beedle's Airshop for 50 Rupees.

tiers.name: Big Bug Net
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Bug Net at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 3 Tumbleweeds, 2 Ancient Flowers, 1 Evil Crystal and 100 Rupees.

items.name: Beetle
items.notes: HD: with button controls you steer it with the right stick; with motion controls you tilt the Joy-Con, as with the Wii Remote.

tiers.name: Beetle
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of Skyview Temple, in the chest after the Stalfos fight.

tiers.name: Hook Beetle
tiers.howTo: Free: in Lanayru Desert, the robot you save from two Technoblins fits it with a claw.
tiers.reward: Carries and drops Bombs and other items

tiers.name: Quick Beetle
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Hook Beetle at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 2 Ancient Flowers, 2 Hornet Larvae, 1 Golden Skull and 50 Rupees.

tiers.name: Tough Beetle
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Quick Beetle at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 3 Ancient Flowers, 4 Amber Relics, 1 Blue Bird Feather, 1 Goddess Plume and 50 Rupees.

items.name: Digging Mitts
items.notes: Zelda Wiki's Upgrade table lists the two the other way round; its item pages, Zelda Dungeon and the story order agree the Digging Mitts come first.

tiers.name: Digging Mitts
tiers.howTo: In Eldin Volcano, a Mogma gives them to you after you beat the Bokoblins that invaded his underground cavern.

tiers.name: Mogma Mitts
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Fire Sanctuary: Silva the Mogma gives them to you for rescuing him.

items.name: Bomb Bag
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Earth Temple: Ledd the Mogma gives it to you after you win it back from two Lizalfos.
items.notes: Holds 10 Bombs, picked from Bomb Flowers or bought at Rupin's Gear Shop (10 for 20 Rupees). Extra bags for the Adventure Pouch are under Capacity.

items.name: Gust Bellows
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Lanayru Mining Facility, in the sand-filled warehouse patrolled by Froaks.
items.notes: Blows away sand and dust, and opens Mallara's house cleaning in Skyloft.

items.name: Goddess's Harp
items.howTo: Zelda gives it to you at the Temple of Time, at the end of the Lanayru Mining Facility.
items.notes: The old woman teaches you to play it. HD: with button controls you strum with the right stick.

items.name: Water Dragon's Scale
items.howTo: The reward for Farore's Silent Realm in Faron Woods.
items.notes: Lets you dive and swim underwater; needed to reach Lake Floria.

items.name: Whip
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Ancient Cistern.
items.notes: Also steals Monster Horns from Bokoblins.

items.name: Clawshots
items.howTo: The reward for Nayru's Silent Realm in Lanayru Desert.
items.notes: A pair: you can chain from target to target. HD: with button controls you aim it with the right stick instead of pointing the Wii Remote.

items.name: Bow
items.notes: Each upgrade adds power and range. HD: with button controls you aim it with the right stick instead of pointing the Wii Remote.

tiers.name: Bow
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Sandship, won from the Scervo fight.

tiers.name: Iron Bow
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Bow at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 3 Tumbleweeds, 1 Evil Crystal, 3 Monster Claws, 2 Eldin Ore and 50 Rupees.

tiers.name: Sacred Bow
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Iron Bow at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 5 Tumbleweeds, 2 Evil Crystals, 3 Lizard Tails, 1 Goddess Plume and 100 Rupees.

items.name: Fireshield Earrings
items.howTo: The reward for Din's Silent Realm in Eldin Volcano.
items.notes: Stop your clothes catching fire in the heat of the Volcano Summit. They don't protect you from lava or fire attacks.

sections.title: Capacity
sections.note: Pouch items: each one carried adds ammunition. Buy more at Rupin's Gear Shop; Gondo upgrades each one. Item Upgrades shares this progress for your first of each, and tracks any more.

items.name: Seed Satchel
items.notes: The Slingshot comes with a satchel for 20 seeds that takes no pouch slot. Samurai Gamers lists 2 Ornamental Skulls for the Medium Seed Satchel; Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon say 3.

tiers.name: Small Seed Satchel
tiers.howTo: Buy one at Rupin's Gear Shop for 100 Rupees once you have the Slingshot, or open the Goddess Chest west of Fun Fun Island (its Goddess Cube is on Eldin Volcano).

tiers.name: Medium Seed Satchel
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Small Seed Satchel at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 4 Amber Relics, 3 Monster Claws, 3 Ornamental Skulls and 50 Rupees.

tiers.name: Large Seed Satchel
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Medium Seed Satchel at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 5 Amber Relics, 3 Monster Claws, 1 Golden Skull, 1 Blue Bird Feather and 100 Rupees.

items.name: Small Bomb Bag
items.notes: Separate from the Bomb Bag you find in the Earth Temple, which holds 10 and takes no pouch slot.

tiers.name: Small Bomb Bag
tiers.howTo: Buy one at Rupin's Gear Shop for 150 Rupees after the Earth Temple, or open the Goddess Chest on top of the Isle of Songs.

tiers.name: Medium Bomb Bag
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Small Bomb Bag at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 1 Lizard Tail, 3 Ornamental Skulls, 1 Blue Bird Feather and 50 Rupees.

tiers.name: Large Bomb Bag
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Medium Bomb Bag at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 3 Lizard Tails, 4 Jelly Blobs, 2 Hornet Larvae, 1 Golden Skull and 100 Rupees.

tiers.name: Small Quiver
tiers.howTo: Buy one at Rupin's Gear Shop for 150 Rupees once you have the Bow, or open the Goddess Chest on the dig-in island in the Thunderhead (its Goddess Cube is on the way to the Fire Dragon at the Volcano Summit).

tiers.name: Medium Quiver
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Small Quiver at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 3 Monster Horns, 3 Dusk Relics, 5 Amber Relics and 50 Rupees.

tiers.name: Large Quiver
tiers.howTo: Upgrade a Medium Quiver at Gondo's Scrap Shop in the Bazaar: 2 Monster Horns, 3 Dusk Relics, 1 Golden Skull, 1 Goddess Plume and 100 Rupees.

items.name: Adventure Pouch
items.howTo: Fledge gives it to you outside the Knight Academy once you have the Goddess Sword.
items.notes: Holds shields, Bottles, medals, quivers, bomb bags and seed satchels. If it's full, a new pouch item goes to the Item Check in the Bazaar.

items.name: Pouch expansion (Pumpkin Landing)
items.howTo: Strike the Goddess Cube in the Deep Woods near Gorko, on the way to Skyview Temple, then open its Goddess Chest on Pumpkin Landing.

items.name: Pouch expansion (300 Rupees)
items.howTo: Buy it at Beedle's Airshop for 300 Rupees.

items.name: Pouch expansion (600 Rupees)
items.howTo: Buy it at Beedle's Airshop for 600 Rupees, after the 300-Rupee one.

items.name: Pouch expansion (1,200 Rupees)
items.howTo: Buy it at Beedle's Airshop for 1,200 Rupees, after the 600-Rupee one.
items.notes: Beedle's last one.

sections.title: Bottles
sections.note: Five Empty Bottles. Each takes a pouch slot.

items.name: Luv's Bottle
items.howTo: Talk to Luv at the Potion Shop in the Bazaar after Zelda falls; she gives you one free.

items.name: Sealed Temple Bottle
items.howTo: Open the chest to the right of the old woman in the Sealed Temple.
items.reward: Empty Bottle, filled with a Revitalizing Potion

items.name: Parrow's Bottle
items.howTo: Parrow paces the Plaza looking for his sister Orielle. Find her stranded with her hurt Loftwing on the small round island just east of Fun Fun Island, then tell Parrow: he gives you his medicine in a Bottle to keep.
items.reward: Empty Bottle, filled with Mushroom Spores
items.notes: Part of Orielle's Gratitude Crystal quest; the Gratitude Crystals tracker has the rest.

items.name: Fire Sanctuary Bottle
items.howTo: With the Mogma Mitts, go back to the first room with a lone Magmanos, open the gate to the water plants, beat the Magmanos with a water bulb and take the ground-level passage west to the chest.

items.name: Thunderhead Bottle
items.howTo: Strike the Goddess Cube on a floating platform in the cave to the Fire Dragon, during the Song of the Hero. Its Goddess Chest is on a small island in the west of the Thunderhead: dig in with the Mogma Mitts, break the boulders in one corner and climb the vines.
items.after: During the Song of the Hero
items.notes: The same island's other corner has the Goddess Chest with a Small Quiver.

sections.title: Wallets
sections.note: Batreaux's four wallets and Beedle's three Extra Wallets.

items.name: Wallet
items.notes: You start with the Small Wallet (300 Rupees). Batreaux, in his house under the Skyloft graveyard, swaps it for a bigger one as you bring him Gratitude Crystals; his rewards are also in the Gratitude Crystals tracker.

tiers.name: Medium Wallet
tiers.howTo: Bring Batreaux 5 Gratitude Crystals.

tiers.name: Big Wallet
tiers.howTo: Bring Batreaux 30 Gratitude Crystals.

tiers.name: Giant Wallet
tiers.howTo: Bring Batreaux 50 Gratitude Crystals.

tiers.name: Tycoon Wallet
tiers.howTo: Bring Batreaux 80 Gratitude Crystals.

items.name: Extra Wallets
items.notes: Each adds 300 Rupees to whatever wallet you have, up to 9,900 with the Tycoon Wallet.

tiers.name: Extra Wallet 1
tiers.howTo: Buy it at Beedle's Airshop for 100 Rupees.

tiers.name: Extra Wallet 2
tiers.howTo: Buy it at Beedle's Airshop for 100 Rupees.

tiers.name: Extra Wallet 3
tiers.howTo: Buy it at Beedle's Airshop for 100 Rupees.
